offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures digital imaging sensors, cameras, instrumentation, aerospace and defense electronics, and engineered systems. Sells to industrial, scientific, defense, aerospace and marine customers worldwide, mostly through direct sales.

primary_products.value: digital imaging sensors and cameras; thermal imaging and infrared systems; test and measurement instruments; marine and environmental instruments; aerospace and defense electronics and unmanned systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial manufacturers, scientific and research labs, medical and life science firms, aerospace and defense contractors, marine and energy companies; B2G: US and allied defense, space and security agencies

end_markets.value: defense and aerospace; industrial automation and manufacturing; life sciences and healthcare; marine and oil and gas; environmental monitoring

revenue_model.value: product sales: sensors, cameras, instruments and electronic components sold to customers; project or contract: engineered systems and defense contracts, including government development and production contracts; service fees: aftermarket repair, calibration and support
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds sensors, cameras, instruments and systems from purchased materials and components, sold to industrial, scientific and defense customers; component supplier: supplies imaging sensors and electronic components into customers' equipment and systems

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia and other regions, with major operations in the US, UK, France, Canada and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: digital imaging, instrumentation, aerospace and defense electronics, and engineered systems sharing sensing technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: own sales teams selling to OEMs, defense primes and government agencies; distributors / dealers: distributors and resellers for instruments and cameras; online: e-commerce for some catalog instruments and components

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: defense export controls (ITAR/EAR), government contracting rules, and environmental and product safety standards
